title: Decision Nº 064/006/2004 CC.D of October 11, 2004
text:
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA 
Nation Religion King 
 
The Constitutional Council 
 
 CASE 
Nº 087/010/2004 
Of October 11, 2004 
 Decision 
Nº 064/006/2004 CC.D 
Of October 11, 2004 
 
 
 
The Constitutional Council 
 
- Seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia of 1993; 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº CS/RKM/0498/06 of April 8, 1998 on the 
Organization and the Functioning of the Constitutional Council; 
- Seen the letter nº 255NA of October 11, 2004 of Samdech HENG SAMRIN, 
Acting President of the National Assembly, requesting the Constitutional Council 
to review the constitutionality of the law on the Organization and the Functioning 
of the Royal Council of the Throne; 
Having heard the rapporteur, 
Having deliberated in compliance with the law , 
 
 -Whereas Samdech HENG SAMRIN; Acting President of the National Assembly, 
by the letter nº 255 NA of October, 2004 to the President of the Constitutional 
council requesting the Constitutional Council to review the constitution ality of the 
law on the Organization and the Functioning of the Royal Council of the Throne, 
which was received by the Secretariat General on the same day at 11:15 AM; that 
therefore the Constitutional Council can examine this request in accordance with 
the Articles 136 N and 140 N of the Constitution and the Articles 15 and 16 of 
the law on the Organization and the Functioning of the Constitutional Council 
promulgated by Preah Reach Kram nº CS/RKM/0498/06 of April 8, 1998; 
-Whereas the Law on the Organi zation and the Functioning of the Royal Council of 
the Throne was legislated after the King sent his Royal Message of October 06, 
2004 to the Buddhist monks and the people requesting their permission for his 
retirement and by virtue of this Royal Message a nd the consecutive once to retire 
means to abdicate. The Message of His Majesty the King has the highest 
authority; 
- Whereas the Law on the Organization and the Functioning of the Royal Council 
of the Throne has 5 chapters divided into 18 articles: 
 
1- Chapter I 
This chapter has 2 articles stipulating the general provision related to the 
objectives of the law and the competence of the Royal Council of the Throne which 
is the elector of the New king; that this chapter conforms to the Article 10 
paragr aph 1 of the Constitution, stipulating that “ the Cambodian Monarchy shall be 
an elective one ”, and to the Article 13N paragraph 3 of the Constitution stipulating 
that “ the Organization and the Functioning of the Royal Council of the Throne 
shall be determi ned by law ”; that chapter 1 is therefore constitutional; 
 2- Chapter II 
This Chapter contains 5 articles relating to the Organization and the 
composition of the Council of the Throne and determines the role and the 
competence of the President, Vice President and the Minister of the Royal Palace 
who must keep secret all minutes and documents of the Royal Council of the 
Throne. The Royal Council of the Throne consists of the President of Senate as 
President, the President of the National Assembly as first Vice President and the 
Prime Minister as second Vice President; that beside s there are 6 other members as 
stipulated in the Article 13N of the Constitution; that therefore Chapter II conforms 
to the Article 13N of the Constitution; 
 3- Chapter III 
This Chapter, which relates to the functioning of the Royal Council of the 
Throne, such as the modalities of meeting, the quorum, the secret of deliberation, 
the adoption, the secret vote, the election of the King among members of the royal 
family as stipulated in the Article 14 of the Constitution, the oath taking, the 
disseminatio n of the decision on the election of the New King as well as the 
coronation, contains 8 articles. Concerning, the Article 10 because retirement 
means abdication as clarified in the above mentioned motives, chapter III is 
therefore constitutional; 
 4- Chapter IV and V 
These two Chapters contain no provision contrary to the Constitution. 
Decides: 
Article 1 : The Law on the Organization and the Functioning of the Royal Council of the 
Throne consisting of 5 Chapters and 18 Articles is declared constitut ional 
Article 2 : The decision made in the plenary session of the Constitutional Council 
in Phnom Penh onOctober 11, 2004 shall be final without recourse, shall have 
authority over all the instituted powers as stipulated in the Constitution and shall 
be pub lished in the “Journal officiel”. 
 
 Phnom Penh, October 11, 2004 
 For the Constitutional Council 
 The President 
 
 Signed and Sealed 
 
 BIN CHHIN
summary: Decision Nº 064/006/2004 CC.D of October 11, 2004: Request of Samdech HENG SAMRIN, Acting President of the National Assembly, to the Constitutional Council for reviewing the constitutionality of the Law on the Organization and the Functioning of the Royal Council of the Throne.
